notes.title: Thirst update!
notes.notes:
Thirst fans - We have a nice update for you today!

UPdates
- Fixed secondary screen issue (Some players didn't get mirrored game play on their monitor) 
- Enemy damage indicator (Hit enemy and it glows red) 
- General bug fixed 

Coming soon:
- Better bullets 
- Smarter AI 
- Maybe a map update if you want it

notes.title: 3/9/18 Thirst Update
notes.notes:
Some minor update 

- At long last, the hands are animated!
- Universal leaderboard (Oculus and Steam)
- Upgraded grenade 
- New visual and sound effects 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Presidents Day Update!
notes.notes:
Minor update for all our new Thirst fans! 

- Add single pass stereo rendering and other performance improvements
- Optimized several models and scene elements
- New plasma grenade 
- Minor map updates

notes.title: The update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925342/4a39d20ef1913225ec81da31bc428086e9e80704.jpg[/img]

Thanks everyone for your amazing feedback and patience while we worked on this update to Thirst VR. 

To get this right, we re-coded the game nearly from scratch. It's an all new map, new enemies and, yes, new weapons! The much desired RPG here and it packs a punch! BOOM TIME! 

Most importantly we've drastically increased performance. We rarely saw dips below 90 FPS during final testing. 

This really is a whole new game. We wanted to ensure everyone who supported Thirst early on didn't have to pay for it again, however, so we released this as a free update. 

We hope you enjoy this new version of THIRST as much as we did making it. 

We can't wait to hear what you think! Your feedback fuels us!

notes.title: Performance Update Released!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925342/6df674e08d02e42890119df0312d5d2e60d25d08.jpg[/img]Thirst fans - Thanks for all the great feedback! We have been hard at work on increasing performance and made significant improvements.

We would love your feedback to see how much of performance increase you are seeing. Our tests how show ~15%.

We also moved the scoreboard keyboard closer (sorry about that!).

New models, map and weapons will be coming in a few weeks! We'll have another performance update in a week after we get feedback.

Thanks everyone!
